name: band10-toolkit
description: Source-first Xiaomi Smart Band 10 watch-face toolkit

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build:example && npm run build:flux && npm run build:preview
scripts.build:rlc: npm run generate:rlc && tsx cli/index.ts build examples/rlc-singularity
scripts.build:video: npm run generate:video && tsx cli/index.ts build examples/video-portrait
scripts.build:backend: npm run generate:backend && tsx cli/index.ts build examples/backend-json
scripts.build:odyssey: npm run generate:odyssey && tsx cli/index.ts build examples/odyssey
scripts.build:glass: npm run generate:glass && tsx cli/index.ts build examples/glass-lock
scripts.build:preview: npm run sync:preview && npm --prefix preview run build
scripts.package:rlc: npm run generate:rlc && tsx cli/index.ts package examples/rlc-singularity
scripts.package:video: npm run generate:video && tsx cli/index.ts package examples/video-portrait
scripts.package:backend: npm run generate:backend && tsx cli/index.ts package examples/backend-json
scripts.package:odyssey: npm run generate:odyssey && tsx cli/index.ts package examples/odyssey
scripts.package:glass: npm run generate:glass && tsx cli/index.ts package examples/glass-lock
scripts.release:faces: npm run package && npm run package:flux && npm run package:circuit && npm run package:rlc && npm run package:backend && npm run package:glass && tsx scripts/collect-release.ts
scripts.preview:rlc: npm run generate:rlc && tsx cli/index.ts preview examples/rlc-singularity
scripts.preview:video: npm run generate:video && tsx cli/index.ts preview examples/video-portrait
scripts.preview:backend: npm run generate:backend && tsx cli/index.ts preview examples/backend-json
scripts.preview:odyssey: npm run generate:odyssey && tsx cli/index.ts preview examples/odyssey
scripts.preview:glass: npm run generate:glass && tsx cli/index.ts preview examples/glass-lock
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && npm --prefix preview run typecheck
scripts.validate:rlc: npm run generate:rlc && tsx cli/index.ts validate examples/rlc-singularity
scripts.validate:video: npm run generate:video && tsx cli/index.ts validate examples/video-portrait
scripts.validate:backend: npm run generate:backend && tsx cli/index.ts validate examples/backend-json
scripts.validate:odyssey: npm run generate:odyssey && tsx cli/index.ts validate examples/odyssey
scripts.validate:glass: npm run generate:glass && tsx cli/index.ts validate examples/glass-lock
